title: Hired Trail
description: A full stack web application to track job applications, manage resumes, and organize interview schedules. It provides a centralized platform for job seekers to stay organized and efficient in their job search process.
idea: The idea came after realizing how chaotic and disorganized the job search process can be. I wanted to create a tool that would help job seekers keep track of their applications, manage their resumes, and stay on top of interview schedules. The goal was to provide a simple yet powerful platform that would make the job search process more manageable and less stressful.

timeline.title: The Idea
timeline.description: After searching through various job tracking tools and finding them either too complex or too basic, I decided to create Hired Trail. I outlined the core features and user experience I wanted to achieve.

timeline.title: Development Phase
timeline.description: Started building the application using Next.js for the frontend and backend. Implement simple application tracking features, resume mabagement, and interview scheduling functionalities. Focused on creating a clean and intuitive user interface with Tailwind CSS.

timeline.title: Launch
timeline.description: Launched Hired Trail to the public. Gathered feedback from early users and started planning for future updates and improvements based on their suggestions.
